figurative_meaning_bn: বিপদের আশঙ্কায় বা ভয়ে ও ভাবনায় দিশেহারা হওয়া
figurative_meaning_en: To become disoriented or bewildered due to fear of impending danger or overwhelming worry and anxiety
similar_in_english: to see stars (from shock or fear)
to be scared out of one's wits
example_sentences_in_bangla: বিপদের আশঙ্কায় তার চোখে অন্ধকার দেখা দিল।
চিন্তায় এতটাই ডুবে গেল যে অন্ধকার দেখতে লাগল।
example_sentences_in_english: In fear of danger, darkness appeared before his eyes.
She was so lost in worry that she started seeing darkness.
note: This idiom vividly captures the psychological state of fear in Bengali culture, often used in storytelling.
